### Model selection (accuracy at validation-tuned threshold)

Best mean CV accuracy: **BPN+SMOTE** (0.7687). Rule: among models whose accuracy is not significantly lower than the best (corrected t-test p > 0.05), take the one with the fewest components (ties: higher accuracy).

| Model | complexity | mean acc | diff vs best | p vs best | candidate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LogReg | 1 | 0.7546 | -0.0141 | 0.496 | yes |
| LogReg+Eng | 2 | 0.7530 | -0.0157 | 0.347 | yes |
| BPN | 3 | 0.7687 | -0.0000 | 0.999 | yes |
| BPN+Fuzzy | 4 | 0.7655 | -0.0033 | 0.834 | yes |
| BPN+Gauss | 4 | 0.7660 | -0.0027 | 0.898 | yes |
| BPN+SMOTE | 4 | 0.7687 | +0.0000 | 1.000 | yes |
| BPN+Eng | 4 | 0.7649 | -0.0038 | 0.814 | yes |
| BPN+Eng+Gauss | 5 | 0.7666 | -0.0022 | 0.917 | yes |
| BPN+Eng+SMOTE | 5 | 0.7557 | -0.0130 | 0.251 | yes |
| GA-BPN | 5 | 0.7606 | -0.0081 | 0.532 | yes |
| GA-Opt | 6 | 0.7568 | -0.0120 | 0.500 | yes |
| GA-Opt+SMOTE | 7 | 0.7617 | -0.0070 | 0.629 | yes |

**Chosen (simplest defensible): LogReg.** Failing to reject equality is weak evidence of equivalence with 15 correlated folds; the test is low-powered, so this rule favours simple models.
